scope: Local read-only review of the separate read-one UDP scheduling prototype. Immutable F and its active 110-window tests are unchanged. No Oracle workload by reviewer.
authorized_change: The user explicitly reopened one-read scheduling; the former 16-packet/EAGAIN preservation condition is not a prohibition. This prototype chooses to retain the existing cross-listener budget and service ordering.
implementation: One step_udp call per listener per owner turn instead of repeatedly calling that listener until false or budget exhaustion. TCP admission and later upstream/control/DHCP/TFTP calls remain in their original positions.

return_path_review.path: Interface work pending, files initializing, absent UDP socket or fd not ready
return_path_review.effect: False return remains unchanged; no new receive.
Datagram consumed; resend state invalidated; false return.
Datagram consumed; resend state invalidated; false return.
False return without clearing the most recent forward; existing empty-read contract retained.
Resend invalidated and receive error recorded; false return.

return_path_review.path: Short packet, QR packet, ACL rejection or deferred interface work
return_path_review.effect: True return counts against the existing budget but no second read from that listener occurs in this turn.

return_path_review.path: Admitted packet, local/cache/forward or deferred EDNS-MAC work
return_path_review.effect: Existing processing and copied deferred state remain unchanged; helper returns true.

fairness_limits: With at most 16 ready listeners returning true, each receives at most one attempt before the next poll; a single busy listener can no longer consume the whole true-return budget.
The budget counts step_udp true returns, not all actual recvmsg attempts. Consumed oversize/Ok(None) and hard-error false paths did not decrement it before and still do not.
With more than 16 continuously busy listeners, fixed iteration order can still starve later listeners. No round-robin policy was added.
Exact C check_dns_listeners returns after the first ready DNS event. This prototype is not identical whole-owner scheduling; its single-ready-UDP path follows the one-read idea.

test_review.new_real_queue_test: Two valid datagrams, a short-invalid first datagram and an oversize false-return first datagram; second packet must remain for the next wait_for_files/step cycle.
test_review.existing_resend_tests: Direct WouldBlock preservation and local/cached/short/QR/oversize/ACL invalidation fixtures remain intact.
test_review.linux_queue_test_execution: Passed in the actual isolated Linux bin suite: 83 ordinary tests plus 4 original ignored tests. See post-f-linux-prototype-gates.json; native debug test evidence is separate from SDK performance qualification.
